name: Deploy via Cloudflare
description: Publish a project through a Cloudflare quick tunnel (no account needed) or to Cloudflare Pages using your connected Cloudflare account, instead of a raw SSH host
phrasings: expose this over a cloudflare tunnel
deploy this as a static site to cloudflare
use cloudflare instead of ssh to deploy

params.name: kind
params.desc: cloudflare-tunnel (no account) or cloudflare-pages (needs Cloudflare connected)

prompt: Deploy {project} using the cloudflare-deploy pack. Run `t3 deploy list --project {project}` first; if no targets exist, ask whether to use a cloudflare-tunnel (no account needed, address changes on restart) or cloudflare-pages (needs Cloudflare connected under Settings → Connections, stable pages.dev address) target before doing anything.
